title: CTSpinoPelvic1K: spine, pelvis, ribs and femora in one coordinate frame, annotated for lumbosacral transitional anatomy
abstract: arXiv:2609.22760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Purpose: A vertebra at the lumbosacral junction is named by counting caudally from C2 on whole-spine imaging, but a lumbar case is planned on lumbar-only imaging (T12 to S1), without C2. Abdominopelvic CT holds that span plus the lowest ribs and pelvis. Where a lumbosacral transitional vertebra (LSTV) alters the count, the local anatomy is ambiguous: four rib-free vertebrae may be an L1 with a lumbar rib or an L5 assimilated to the sacrum, and six may be a sixth lumbar vertebra, a T12 with aplastic ribs, or a lumbarized S1. CTSpinoPelvic1K asks whether local morphology resolves it without the count. CTSpine1K's vertebrae and CTPelvic1K's pelvis covered these patients but were never joined; this release joins them on one series and adds the bones neither had. It provides 802 CT records with per-level ribs and femora, levels anchored on the lowest rib-bearing vertebra and S1, and classes for L6, T13, a separate S1 and lumbar ribs, so ano

translated_title: CTSpinoPelvic1K：统一坐标系下的脊柱、骨盆、肋骨与股骨数据集，并针对腰骶移行解剖进行标注
translated_abstract: 目的：在全脊柱影像上，腰骶交界处的椎体是通过从C2向下计数来命名的，但腰椎手术的规划仅基于腰椎影像（T12至S1），其中不包含C2。腹盆腔CT恰好涵盖这一范围，并包含最下位的肋骨和骨盆。当腰骶移行椎（LSTV）改变了椎体计数时，局部解剖就会产生歧义：四节无肋椎体可能是带有腰肋的L1，也可能是与骶骨融合的L5；六节则可能是第六腰椎、肋骨发育不全的T12，或发生腰椎化的S1。CTSpinoPelvic1K旨在探讨仅凭局部形态能否在没有计数参考的情况下解决这一歧义。CTSpine1K的椎体数据和CTPelvic1K的骨盆数据虽覆盖了这些患者，但二者从未被合并；本发布版本将它们在同一影像序列上合并，并补充了两者均未包含的骨骼。该数据集提供802条CT记录，包含逐节段标注的肋骨和股骨，以最下位带肋椎体和S1作为节段锚定点，并设有L6、T13、独立S1和腰肋等类别，从而为解剖学……
tldr: 发布了CTSpinoPelvic1K数据集，将802条CT记录中的脊柱、骨盆、肋骨和股骨统一在同一坐标系中，并针对腰骶移行椎进行标注，以解决缺乏C2计数参考时椎体命名的歧义问题。
en_tdlr: CTSpinoPelvic1K is a dataset of 802 CT records unifying spine, pelvis, ribs and femora in one coordinate frame, annotated for lumbosacral transitional anatomy to resolve vertebral counting ambiguity without C2.
